preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 10,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= 100 and 1 <= y <= 100 for x, y in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each pair of integers x and y in the test cases is between 1 and 100.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(a, int) and isinstance(b, int) for a, b in results)
postconditions.description: Both a and b in the results are integers.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= 10**9 and 1 <= b <= 10**9 for a, b in results)
postconditions.description: Both a and b in the results are between 1 and 10^9.

postconditions.expression: all(x * (b ** a) == y if a > 0 else x == y for (x, y), (a, b) in zip(test_cases, results))
postconditions.description: If a > 0, x multiplied by b raised to the power of a equals y. If a is 0, x equals y.
